nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the focus of MSIs that follow the continuous improvement model?
nodes.answer: MSIs that follow the continuous improvement model focus on jointly developing principles and indicators to capture and achieve self-imposed sustainability goals negotiated by participating actors and stakeholder groups.
nodes.paragraph: The litera- ture contains various narratives of MSI approaches (Sian- gulube 2024 ), but two forms of MSI appear particularly frequently: On the one hand, there are standard-setting MSIs such as the Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) (Gar- relts and Flitner 2011 ) or the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) (Schouten et al. 2012 ), in which actors negotiate the concrete development and application of product or service certi cations. On the other hand, MSIs exist that correspond to the continuous improvement model (Buckley et al. 2019 ). The MSI analyzed in this paper corresponds to this type, in which members jointlydevelop principles and indicators to capture and achieve self-imposed sustainability goals that are negotiated by participating actors and stakeholder groups. This typicallyfocuses on a sector S entire set of relationships along the global value chain with the goal of achieving successive improvements (Buckley et al. 2019 ).
